  SELECT substr("Order Date", 1, 4) AS "Year",
         SUM("Total Revenue") AS revenue

growth AS (

         (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY "Year")) * 100.0

   ORDER BY "Year" DESC

   FROM growth
   WHERE "YoY Growth (%)" IS NOT NULL)
) AS "Projected Growth Rate (%)"

question: 依照過去趨勢，2026 年整體營收大概會是多少？
label: block
sql_query:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT CAST(substr("Order Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         SUM("Total Revenue") AS revenue
  FROM sales_data
  WHERE CAST(substr("Order Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 2026
  GROUP BY CAST(substr("Order Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
         SUM(year) AS sx,
         SUM(revenue) AS sy,
         SUM(year * revenue) AS sxy,
         SUM(year * year) AS sxx
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT CASE
         WHEN n <= 1 THEN ROUND(sy, 2)
         ELSE ROUND(
           (sy - ((sxy - sx * sy) / NULLIF(sxx - n * sx * sx, 0)) * sx) / n
           + ((sxy - sx * sy) / NULLIF(sxx - n * sx * sx, 0)) * 2026,
           2
         )
       END AS "Estimated 2026 Revenue"
FROM stats;

question: 下季度營收冠軍是誰？
label: block
sql_query:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX("Order Date") AS max_date
  FROM sales_data
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(substr(max_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS y,
    CAST(substr(max_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS m,
    (CAST(substr(max_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS q
  FROM latest
),
next_q AS (
  SELECT
    CASE q
      WHEN 1 THEN date(y || '-04-01')
      WHEN 2 THEN date(y || '-07-01')
      WHEN 3 THEN date(y || '-10-01')
      ELSE date((y + 1) || '-01-01')
    END AS start_date,
    CASE q
      WHEN 1 THEN date(y || '-07-01')
      WHEN 2 THEN date(y || '-10-01')
      WHEN 3 THEN date((y + 1) || '-01-01')
      ELSE date((y + 1) || '-04-01')
    END AS end_date
  FROM bounds
)
SELECT s."Customer Name"
FROM sales_data AS s
CROSS JOIN next_q
WHERE s."Order Date" >= next_q.start_date AND s."Order Date" < next_q.end_date
GROUP BY s."Customer Name"
ORDER BY SUM(s."Total Revenue") DESC, s."Customer Name" ASC
LIMIT 1
